definitions.short: a family descent ; also a sewer
definitions.full: H4163. motsaah [ מוֺצָאָה ] noun feminine only plural: a. Micah 5:1 מוֺצָאוֺתָיו (compare future ruler out of Bethlehem), his origin . b. 2Kin 10:27 Qr מוֺצָאוֺת places of going out to , i.e. a privy (compare Arabic ; German Abtritt ), euphemistically for Kt מַחֲרָאוֺת .
